info.title: LMOxide API
info.description: Administration and status of an LMOxide (LEGO Minifigures Online) server.

get.summary: List accounts, by username. Scope: read.

X-Total-Count.description: How many accounts match the search in all

post.summary: Create an account. Scope: admin.

get.summary: One account with its characters. Scope: read.

delete.summary: Delete an account with its character and friendships (kicks it first). Scope: admin.

patch.summary: Rename an account or change its GM level (from its next login). Scope: admin.

post.summary: Ban an account and disconnect it. Scope: moderate.
Set or remove an account's password (ends its sessions). Scope: admin.
Lift an account's ban. Scope: moderate.

get.summary: List API keys. Scope: admin.

post.summary: Create an API key (e.g. for a Discord bot); the secret is shown once. Scope: admin.

delete.summary: Revoke an API key. Scope: admin.

get.summary: Administrative actions, newest first. Scope: admin.

post.summary:
Sign in with a `login` code the Discord bot sent: a session for the linked account with
`password_reset`, in which `/v1/me/password` takes a new password without the current one.
401 `bad_code` for a wrong or expired code, or a banned account (counts as a failed login).
Log in with a game account; returns a session token.
End the current session.
Create a game account (only when `registration` is `open`).

Trade the current session for a new one (a new token and expiry; the old token stops
working), so a remembered sign-in lasts while it is used. Banned accounts can't renew.
Send a chat line from "Server" to everyone online. Scope: moderate.

get.summary:
The client's animations: animation attributes (what `!anim <attribute>` plays), motion sets
and anim graphs. Scope: read.
The character states (`!state <value>`) and substates the client knows, by name. Scope: read.

The client's effect packages and particle systems: timelines, particles, sounds, animation
attributes, code hooks, Lua, and the items and spells that use them
(tools/re/extract_effect_catalog.py). Scope: read.

Every monster data (look) in the client, with its motion set, anim graph, death effect and
what uses it: the choices for `!skin <id>`. Scope: read.

A sound an effect package plays (`sounds[].id`), as Ogg Vorbis from the client's RDB (type
1020002). Needs `--client-dir`; 503 without it. Scope: read.

What the test commands accept: commands with usage, target kinds with their numbered targets,
test scenarios, dialogues, loot kinds, spawnable enemies and smashables, and monster data
looks (the game server's devcmd.rs). For tools that offer them as choices. Any account (and
read-scope keys).

Characters by name (their in-game names), with the account each belongs to: who plays a
character, for tools such as a Discord bot. Scope: read.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only characters whose name contains this (case-insensitive).

get.summary: A saved character. Scope: read.

patch.summary:
Rename a character (its name must not be another account's character's). An online one is
renamed through its game server and sent again where it stands, so everyone sees the new
name. Scope: admin.

post.summary:
Take achievements away from a character (to earn them again, or to fix a mistake): some by
id, or all of them. A removed exploration or collectible achievement's finds go too. Through
the game server: at once in game when the character is online, else in the database.
Scope: admin.

get.summary: How this API is set up: registration, GM level thresholds.

post.summary:
Create a game account linked to a Discord account, with a key that acts as it. Not while
registration is `closed`. Scope: discord.

A one-time code (`XXXX-XXXX`, 10 minutes, works once) for the bot to send to that Discord
user in a DM; it replaces their last one for the same purpose. `link`: the Discord account
must not be linked yet (409); `login`: it must be (404). Scope: discord.

get.summary:
Requests waiting for a target linked to Discord that the bot hasn't sent by DM yet, oldest
first. The bot polls this, DMs each target and marks it sent. Scope: discord.

post.summary: The bot sent the target this request (it isn't listed again). Scope: discord.

get.summary: Every game account linked to a Discord account. Scope: discord.
The game account linked to a Discord account. Scope: discord.

delete.summary:
Unlink a Discord account; the keys that act as its game account are revoked, the account
stays. Scope: discord.

patch.summary: Change the GM level of a linked account (from its next login). Scope: discord.

post.summary:
A new key that acts as the linked account (named `discord-bot`; it replaces the account's
earlier one). Its scope follows the account's GM level. Scope: discord.

get.summary:
The running copies of worlds (game modes' main copies, team copies, previews) with their
players and NPCs, and the AI's tick time. Scope: moderate.

post.summary: Switch maintenance mode: while on, only accounts with a GM level can log in. Scope: admin.

get.summary: The logged-in account.

post.summary:
Run a test command as one's own character online, as if typed in chat: the game server
decides by the account's GM level which commands run (`GET /v1/catalog/test-commands`
`gm_level`; alpha testers have teleporting, scenarios, minifigures, dialogues, achievements,
animations and looks). Any account.

Link the logged-in account to the Discord account that got this `link` code from the bot.
401 `bad_code` for a wrong or expired code (counts as a failed login); 409 if either is
linked already.

get.summary: The caller's account friends and requests either way, by username. Any account.

post.summary:
Ask another account to be friends (all your characters with all theirs). If they had asked
you already, you are friends at once (`state: friends`). Any account.

delete.summary:
Stop being friends with another account (the friendships it made between their characters
and yours go; ones from before or made in game stay), or withdraw a request either way. Any
account.

post.summary:
Accept another account's request: every character of each becomes friends with every
character of the other. Any account (the request's target).

Turn down another account's request (it is deleted; they may ask again). Any account (the
request's target).

Change the logged-in account's password (ends its sessions). `current_password` may be left
out in a `password_reset` session (from `/v1/auth/code`).

get.summary:
The logged-in account's characters online (the dev UI's debugger for players without the
read scope). Any account.

post.summary:
Change the logged-in account's username (its login name; sessions stay). Once every
`username_cooldown_days` (`/v1/config`), except for admins. `current_password` may be left
out for an account without a password or in a `password_reset` session.

get.summary: Every minifigure: name, attacks, upgrade names by bit, parts.
Characters in play, by in-game name.
get.description: Public unless the API runs with `--private-status`.

get.summary: Everyone logged in, with account details. Scope: read.

post.summary:
Run a test command (the game server's devcmd.rs: `!fx`, `!skin`, `!state`, `!tp`, ...) as the
player, as if typed in chat; the player's GM level still decides whether it runs. For tools
such as an effect browser that preview things in the game client. Scope: admin.
Disconnect a player. Scope: moderate.

get.summary: Playfield ids in the other answers, with their names (worlds, dungeons, the LEGO Center).
Server status.
get.description: Public unless the API runs with `--private-status`.

get.summary: Token ids (minifigure parts, as in `Character.tokens`) with their names.
What the API and the game server were built from: version, git commit and when.
get.description: Public unless the API runs with `--private-status`.

oneOf.description: The ban in force, if any.

characters.description: Its characters. `name` is empty for one still on the creation screen.

discord_id.description: The linked Discord user id (a snowflake, as a string); `null`: not linked.

username_changed_at.description:
Unix time the account last changed its own username (`POST /v1/me/username`; the
cooldown, `username_cooldown_days` in `/v1/config`, counts from it); `null`: never.

AccountFriend.description: Another account as the caller sees it.

AccountFriendState.description: How the caller stands with another account.

AnimGraph.description: RDB 1050003: an EMotion FX anim graph (blend setup).

attributes.description: Its parameters: the animation attributes it reacts to.

motions.description: The motion ids its nodes play.

AnimationCatalog.description:
Motion sets, anim graphs and the animation attributes effect packages set
(data/animations.json, tools/re/extract_animations.py).

account_id.description:
Set: the key acts as this account, and its scope follows the account's GM level as a
login session's does (`scope` is then `read` and unused).

ApiScope.description: What a credential may do; each includes the ones before it.

target.description: What the action was about; for accounts, the username at the time.

target_account_id.description: For actions on an account: its id (the account may since have been deleted).

until.description: Unix time the ban ends; `null`: permanent.

days.description: Length in days; permanent without it.

about.description: What the client does in it, where known.

groups.description: The action groups allowed in it.

BccStates.description:
The character states the client defines (stat 20, BCCState: `!state <value>`) and substates,
from its behaviour tree (data/bcc_states.json, tools/re/extract_bcc_states.py).

message.description: 1-500 characters, shown in every player's chat from "Server".

BuildInfo.description: What a program was built from.

commit.description: The full git commit hash; `null` when built without git (and no `LMOXIDE_GIT_COMMIT`).

current_password.description: Required if the account has a password, except in a `password_reset` session.

counters.description:
Achievement counters: stat -> minifigure template (0 = the player) -> value (stat 3000116
enemies defeated, 3000126 smashables smashed, 3000112/3000113 per-minifigure counters).

defeats.description: What the character defeated, by name (enemies, champions, bosses, smashables).

finds.description: Collectibles and places found ("<playfield>:<world object name>") -> unix time.

level.description:
Player level; 0 = never set (a game server without `--progression` plays every
character at level 30).

minifigure_ranks.description: Minifigure ranks (0..8) by item template, where set (`--progression`).

mode.description: The game mode the character belongs to: `progression`, `maxed` or `world-editor`.

team.description: Minifigure item templates in team order (the first is active).

tokens.description: Token counters (minifigure parts): token id -> gained, spent.

upgrades.description: Active upgrade bitmask per minifigure template.

CharacterChanges.description:
A character's new name: 1 to 3 words of up to 32 characters (created characters have
"first nick last"; others see the middle word above it).

CharacterMatch.description: A character found by name, with its account.

mode.description: The game mode the character belongs to: `progression`, `maxed` or `world-editor`.
The game mode the character belongs to: `progression`, `maxed` or `world-editor`.

saved_at.description: Unix time of the last save.

code.description: As sent by the bot; any case, the dash optional.

remember.description: As in the login: a long session or a short one.

CodePurpose.description: What a one-time code is for.

command.description: A test command as typed in chat, e.g. `!fx 163540`, `!skin 2212`, `!state 29`.

affected.description: How many players it reached (0: not online).

replies.description:
What the server answered in the player's chat while running it (e.g. `effect package
1748 (12 of 2518)`, a usage line, `Test commands need a GM level.`). Lines that come
later (after a teleport, during a dialogue) aren't here.

secret.description: The secret, shown only now: send as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.

first_at.description: Unix times of the first and the last.

DiscordLink.description: A game account linked to a Discord account.

banned.description: Whether a ban is in force.

discord_id.description: The Discord user id (a snowflake, as a string).

key.description: The new account's key (it acts as the account).

discord_id.description: The Discord user id (a snowflake, as a string).

name.description:
Its name in the client data, e.g. "Global_Smash 1000 Monsters" (empty: not an
achievement, story or tutorial progress).

title.description:
As the game shows it: its title ("Fiery Explorer"), the title of the achievement it is
part of ("Paleontologist") and its text ("Find the Volcano Summit in Dinosaur Rise.").

allOf.description:
What EffectPackageIIR plays (`!fx <id>`): timelines of particles, sounds, animation
attributes, Lua, ... Packages have no names of their own: `used_by` names them.

oneOf.description:
What EffectPackageIIR plays (`!fx <id>`): timelines of particles, sounds, animation
attributes, Lua, ... Packages have no names of their own: `used_by` names them.

allOf.description: A particle effect packages refer to by resource name.

oneOf.description: A particle effect packages refer to by resource name.

EffectCatalog.description:
The client's effect packages and particle systems (data/effect_catalog.json,
tools/re/extract_effect_catalog.py).

code_hooks.description: Code hooks its timelines start at (`onhit`, `charge`, `execute`, ...): `!fx <id> <hook>`.

FriendRequestNotice.description: A request waiting for a target linked to Discord that the bot hasn't sent yet.

discord_id.description: The target's Discord user id (a snowflake, as a string).

Instance.description: A running copy of a world.

characters.description: Characters in it (players and the NPCs that joined the world: pets, escorts).

copy.description:
0, 1, 2: the progression, maxed and world editor modes' main copies; 3 and up: extra
copies (a team's pocket world, an open world past its cap, a preview).

key.description: The key clients know it by.

Instances.description: Every running copy of a world, and how long the NPCs' AI takes.

ai_tick_ms.description: The last AI tick (every copy with players), ms, and the longest in the last minute.

open_world_cap.description: Players an open world's copy takes before arrivals get another.

reason.description: Shown to the player in chat.

remember.description:
Stay signed in: the session lasts `--remember-days` instead of `--session-ttl-hours`
(for a token kept across browser restarts; renew it with `/v1/auth/renew`).

names.description: Names of the characters with this look.

MonsterCatalog.description:
Every monster data (RDB 1010514): the looks `!skin <id>` takes (data/monster_data.json,
tools/re/extract_monster_data.py).

anim_graph.description: Its anim graph (`anim_graphs`): which animation attributes it reacts to.

death_effect_package.description: The effect package played when it is defeated.

minifigures.description: Minifigure item templates with this body (GET /v1/minifigures).

used_by.description: What the world places with this look.

MotionSet.description: RDB 1050004: a look's motions by id.

password.description: Without one the account can't log in until a password is set.

id.description: RDB 1010207 id (`null`: not in the client's name index).

name.description: Resource name (`null`: a package names it by id and the index has no name for it).

copy.description: Which running copy of the playfield (`/v1/instances`); `null` until it is in play.

heading.description:
The way the character faces, in degrees: 0 along +z, 90 along +x; `null` until it is in
play.

position.description: Where the character is now (x, y up, z); `null` until it is in play.

teleport.description: A `!tp` destination (with an arrival point); the others are the tutorial, layers, test maps.

PublicPlayer.description: A player as anyone may see them (in-game names only).

code.description: As sent by the bot; any case, the dash optional.

RemoveAchievementsRequest.description: Achievements to take away: `ids`, or with `all` every one.

all.description:
Remove every achievement, and the journal (finds, defeats, visits) and achievement
counters, so they can be earned again. Story and tutorial progress (tags that aren't
achievements), stars and XP stay.

ids.description: Achievement ids (tags) to remove; the earned "all of" achievements above them go too.

online.description:
The character was online: its client was updated at once (counters show again after
its next login).

remember.description: As in the login: a long session (`--remember-days`) or a short one.

ServerConfig.description: How this API is set up, for clients that adapt to it (always public).

admin_gm_level.description: GM level from which an account's login session has the admin scope.

editor_gm_level.description: GM level from which an account may use the world editor (`/v1/survey`, `/v1/editor`).

moderator_gm_level.description: GM level from which an account's login session has the moderate scope.

private_status.description: Whether `/v1/status` and `/v1/online` need a read-scope credential (`--private-status`).

username_cooldown_days.description:
Days an account waits between changes of its own username (`POST /v1/me/username`);
admins (`admin_gm_level`) don't wait.

password_reset.description:
A session from a one-time sign-in code (`/v1/auth/code`): `/v1/me/password` takes a new
password without the current one.

oneOf.description: `null`: the account may only see and change itself (`/v1/me`).

password.description: `null` removes the password (the account can't log in).

id.description: RDB 1020002 id (Ogg Vorbis): GET /v1/catalog/sounds/{id}. `null`: not in the client.

path.description: As the package names it, e.g. `sfx\swishes\swish_blade_throw_1.wav`.

started_at.description: Unix time the game server started.

TestCatalog.description:
What the test commands accept, for tools that offer them as choices (the game server's
devcmd.rs). Targets and spawnable names come from the world as loaded; their numbers are
what `!goto <kind> <n>`, `!test <n>` and `!dialog <n>` take.

looks.description: `!skin <monster data>`: the looks of the world's characters and smashables

gm_level.description: The GM level the command needs (alpha testers have some of them).

team.description: Minifigure names of the team it sets, the first active; empty: the team stays.

Timeline.description: One part of a package: a particle, a sound, an animation attribute, Lua, ...

duration.description:
Seconds; `null` when the part sets none (it lasts as long as its content, e.g. a sound)
or lasts until the package is stopped (`until_stopped`). 0: an instant (Lua, an attribute).

hook.description: The code hook that starts this part's timeline (`null`: when the package starts).

start.description: Seconds after the package (or its code hook) starts.

target.description: self, target, client, ground, other, mount.

type.description: particle, sound, emotionfxattribute, lua, environmenteffect, movement, camerapath, ...

until_stopped.description: The designers' "forever": it lasts until the package is stopped.

minifigure.description: The minifigure this is a part of.

UsedBy.description:
An item template (RDB 1000620) or spell (1000621) whose data mention the id (a byte search:
a few may be coincidences).

oneOf.description: The game server; `null` while it doesn't answer (or is older than this route).

game_server_started_at.description: Unix time the game server started.

first_at.description: Unix times of the first and the last.

bearer.description: An API key or a session token from /v1/auth/login (both start with lmox_)

tags.name: admin
tags.description: API keys and the audit log

tags.name: friends
tags.description: Account friends: every character of each account friends with every character of the other

tags.name: discord
tags.description: For the Discord bot (scope discord): Discord accounts linked to game accounts, their account keys, one-time codes

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: Game data from the client: effects, looks, animations, character states, test commands
